description: Source code for DebugController class managing debugging, recording, and UI interactions in Playwright's internal server module.

classes.name: DebugController
classes.description: Manages debugging, recording, and UI interactions within Playwright's server environment.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets the SDK language for the debug controller.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disables report state changes.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables tracking of page hierarchy changes.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Configures the recorder mode, including starting/stopping recording and browser setup.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights elements or ARIA templates in the UI.

methods.name: hideHighlight
methods.description: Removes all highlights from the UI.

methods.name: _emitSnapshot
methods.description: Emits a snapshot of the current page state.

methods.name: _allRecorders
methods.description: Retrieves all recorder instances associated with the current contexts.

methods.name: _closeBrowsersWithoutPages
methods.description: Closes browsers that have no open pages.
